mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hospital_bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND hospital_id = #{hospitalId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hospital_bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND hospital_id = #{hospitalId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.name, h.phone, h.address, h.detail_address AS detailAddress, h.latitude, h.longitude, h.is_emergency_24h AS isEmergency24h, h.business_hours AS businessHours, h.rating, h.review_count AS reviewCount, h.naver_place_url AS naverPlaceUrl, h.is_active AS isActive FROM hospital_bookmarks b JOIN hospitals h ON h.id = b.hospital_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.id DESC
